contexts.text: Seed as the sand () = good.

As the sand which is upon the sea shore () = the multitude of corresponding scientifics... The sand = scientifics in special and in particular. Scientifics are compared to that sand, because the little stones of which sand consists, in the internal sense, are scientifics.
Stars. or Knowledges, relate to the Rational; and the sand of the sea shore, or scientifics, to the Natural.

Joseph heaped up corn as the sand of the sea () = the multiplication of truth from good... When the multiplication of (truth in the will and act) is compared to the sand of the sea, it signifies that it is from good.
One scruple is like a grain of sand placed close before the pupil of the eye.
He hid him in the sand () = that he relegated it where falsities are... Sand = scientific truth; here, scientific falsity; for the reason that stone, from which comes sand, signifies both.
The covered things of the hidden things of the sand () = the arcana of scientific truths. ( = the spiritual things which lie concealed in the sense of the letter of the Word. AE 445:5.)
Those who have studied knowledges (merely) to be called learned; and those who have not cultivated the Rational by them... love sandy places... because sandy places correspond to such studies.
a. He who is in the doctrine of a false religion, and has confirmed its falsity... is not even in a forest, but is outside it in a sandy plain, where there is no grass.
Even from sand there breathes forth that which contributes aid to producing something, thus to effecting something.
Around those in faith separated from charity, there is not even grass, but sand. SE 6044. SE 6046.
(They were then seen) in a sandy place.
a. I stood upon the sand of the sea () = his spiritual natural state now such as is with those in the First Heaven. Explained.
The satyrs... sprinkled sand upon the place of slaughter.
The number of whom is as the sand of the sea () = the multitude of such... By the sand is signified that which serves no use in the sea, except to make the bottom.
As when one is walking in deep sand...
He then saw nothing but sandy places...
Those in faith separated from charity are meant by... those who build their house upon the sand (). Sand = faith separated from charity.
The sand of the sea () = these Knowledges in the natural man.
The sand () = Divine truth received only in the memory, and thence a little in the thought, and thus scattered and disconnected, because corrupted by falsities, and falsified by ideas.

I stood upon the sand of the sea = a continuation of the state of those who are signified by the dragon. Explained. Moreover, by the sand of the sea is signified what is barren, such as is with those who do think about faith, but nothing about the life of faith, which is charity; for where such dwell there appears nothing but heaps of stones, and also sand...
That all truths will be destroyed through falsities, is signified by he shall gather captivity as the sand ().
